notes: Gravimetric H2 uptake (Hiden IGA-003 to 20 bar; Hiden Xemis to 150 bar) measured by the authors on KOH-activated and compactivated carbons (PPY2-4, MPPY2-4, S4800, S4800P, densified PPY4/MPPY4 variants), at -196 C and at room temperature; AX21 benchmark also measured (SI Fig. S9, S13). The text layer drops the minus sign ('196 1C'); the page image (main-03, main-04) shows '-196 C'. Surface area is BET, N2 at -196 C, P/Po 0.04-0.2 (main p. 3, Porosity analysis). Majority carbon: polypyrrole-derived carbons keep only ca. 0.4-0.75 wt% N after activation (main p. 4); the paper reports activated carbons. No retraction statement found in main text or SI, is_retracted is false; no statement that all H2 values were published before; the article is a Rapid Communication reporting new data.
